summary: GFL Environmental Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting voting results from its annual and special meeting of shareholders held on May 13, 2026. All director nominees were elected, auditors reappointed, and equity incentive plans renewed as described in the management information circular. The filing is a normal routine meeting report with no special-situation corporate transaction or event. Shareholders voted on standard items: director elections (with some notable withhold votes), auditor appointment, and plan renewals. There are no deal terms, strategic review, activist campaign, or capital return elements. This is a regular governance update with no risk-arb or transaction angle to monitor.
